scope: F07/F11 local SVG import and strict shared single-path construction; professional-editor roadmap remains incomplete

implementation.editable: OO path/shape/group/solid-paint/compound-mask/local-use/embedded-raster import; native commands and normal subsequent history
implementation.flatten: Explicit browser SVG image decode followed by bounded native PNG tiles, with original XML/editability losses disclosed
implementation.admission: Dedicated terminable xmldom worker; no live markup insertion, script/event/foreignObject/SMIL/CSS animation/DTD/entity/external resource execution
implementation.publication: Validate worker data and complete staged assets before guarded tab publication; starting revision/session/asset lifetime and signal/progress failures reject atomically
implementation.singlePath: Strict M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z conversion; quadratic exact conversion, reported cubic arc approximation; malformed or compound single-path input rejects
implementation.sourcePreservation: Original embedded static PNG/JPEG/WebP bytes/dimensions survive native project save/reopen; source SVG XML/IDs/CSS/master identity are not archived
additionalCorrections: Unpainted and zero-alpha geometry remains editable
Negative widths, invalid opacity, cyclic uses and unrepresentable native content cannot silently publish partial artwork

verification.build: npm run build: actual WASM/runtime/docs/TypeScript/production bundling passed

unit.execution: local loopback authorized; initial restricted attempt failed REST server bind

development.files: all nine SVG browser files plus editor.e2e.ts
development.coverage: new import fixture count is checked below; includes source geometry, PNG/JPEG/WebP bytes, native save/reopen/history, UI preflight/picker/drop/UTF-16, stale/cancel/dispose/callback failures, resource release, XML external/executable rejection, supported export/reimport, genuine 50 MP and existing SVG/editor regressions

production.newWorkflow: No developer globals; actual XML worker, preflight editable import, expected decoded PNG samples, prior document retained and exact documented isolated path example with one undo

geometryComparison.method: Source browser SVG contour lengths and 101 normalized-length points per contour vs independently browser-measured imported cubic paths
geometryComparison.pixelMethod: Keep raw max alpha/premultiplied residuals. Require stable interiors within 3 bytes, threshold contours within one pixel neighborhood, area/centroid checks, zero opaque/transparent holes and independent viewBox-circle radius sampling. These are not pixel identity or proof of a particular raster rounding cause.

limitations: Not complete F07/F11 or complete roadmap delivery. Gradient/text/CSS/effect/clip/mask/non-round-stroke graphs require explicit flatten; broad identity/graph round-trip remains open.
Native Canvas and SVG curve/clip/image coverage differ; arc conversion is approximate without a universal error bound.
Native image decode/individual render/encoding calls are cooperative and cannot be preempted mid-call. XML worker termination and final guards suppress cancelled/stale publication.
Original SVG XML/IDs/CSS/editor metadata and shared use identity are not archived. Flattening discards original geometry/type/effects and off-viewport content.
Browser/source decode, native validation, resident source bitmaps, XML/base64/compressed output and viewer memory impose real limits; no arbitrary file-size/MP import cap.
Single observed 50 MP completion times are not p95, input-to-photon, long-task, peak-memory, controlled speedup, hardware GPU or universal device/fidelity acceptance.
validationStages: Initial browser pass: 9/20 passed; ten strict pixel-maximum checks and one unawaited sample-open assertion failed. Raw logs retained.

Second browser pass: 21/22 passed; a coverage-centroid check failed on the viewBox/circle fixture. Browser curve and analytic-circle checks distinguish actual geometry from retained coverage residuals.
A broad pass was intentionally interrupted after review identified invisible-geometry loss and inline important priority; both were fixed with unit/browser regressions before final testing.

Initial production case reached correct output/undo but failed an exact accessible tab-name assertion because existing dirty-state UI appends Unsaved changes; the corrected check asserts restored document name and empty undo stack.
Final full build, 980 unit/API, 228 development browser and 35 production cases pass.
